_doc: Player options. wasd_movement: keyboard movement in addition to click-to-move (off; when on, W stays on 2 only). camera_zoom: 1.0 (default, more view) or 1.5 (larger; whole pixels either way). screen_shake: 0..1. auto_pickup: none, all, or a rarity and better (common, magic, rare, unique) taken by walking over.
